verses.gurmukhi: ਮਹਤਾ ਸਕਤੁ ਆਗਰੈ ਚਢਾ ਹੋਆ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: mahataa sakat aagarai chaddaa hoaa nihaal nihaalaa|

en.bdb: Saktu Mehta and Nihalu Chaddha of Agra have become blest.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੜ੍ਹੀਅਲੁ ਮਥਰਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸਪਰਵਾਰਾ ਲਾਲ ਗੁਲਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: gaRheeal matharaa dhaas hai saparavaaraa laal gulaalaa|

en.bdb: Bhai Garhial and Mathara Das and their families are said to have been dyed in the red colour of love for the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੰਗਾ ਸਹਗਲੁ ਸੂਰਮਾ ਹਰਵੰਸ ਤਪੇ ਟਹਲ ਧਰਮਸਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: ga(n)gaa sahagal sooramaa harava(n)s tape Tahal dharamasaalaa|

en.bdb: Ganga belonging to Sahagal caste is brave and Harbans, the hermit serves in the dharamsala, the inn for the pilgrims.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਣਦੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ਮਹਾਂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਲਿਆਣਾ ਕੁਲਿ ਕਵਲੁ ਰਸਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: anadh muraaree mahaa(n) purakh kaliaanaa kul kaval rasaalaa|

en.bdb: Murari of Anand caste is a saint of high order and Kalyana is the house of love and pure like lotus.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨੋ ਲਟਕਣੁ ਬਿੰਦਰਾਉ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪੂਰਣ ਘਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: naano laTakan bi(n)dharaau sevaa sa(n)gat pooran ghaalaa|

en.bdb: Bhai Nano, Bhai Latakan and Bind Rao have served the congregation with full labour and love.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਾਂਡਾ ਆਲਮ ਚੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਸੈਸਾਰਾ ਤਲਵਾੜੁ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: haa(n)ddaa aalam cha(n)dh hai saisaaraa talavaaR sukhaalaa|

en.bdb: Alam Chand Handa, Sainsara Talvar are the Sikhs who live with all happiness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਗਨਾ ਨੰਦਾ ਸਾਧ ਹੈ ਭਾਨੂ ਸੁਹੜੁ ਹੰਸਾਂ ਦੀ ਢਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: jaganaa na(n)dhaa saadh hai bhaanoo suhaR ha(n)saa(n) dhee ddaalaa|

en.bdb: Jagana and Nanda both are sadhus and Bhana of Suhar caste is competent like swan to have discerned from the real from false.
These, all fellow disciples of the Guru, are like the jewels of a string.
